alloy.preparation: Rolled austenitic steel sheet, 20Cr-25Ni. Electrochemical specimens 40 × 20 × 1.5 mm; annealed in vacuo at 1050 °C for 2 h and water quenched at 0 °C. Mechanically polished with emery paper through No. 6/0, cloth polished using diluted chromium-oxide suspension, degreased with absolute ethyl alcohol, washed in distilled water, and air-blast dried. Masked with Teflon seal tape on an epoxy-resin undercoating, leaving 1 cm² exposed.

test_solution.preparation: Solutions described as approximately neutral; deaerated by bubbling pure nitrogen for more than 30 min. Continuation of gas flow during measurement is not stated.

test_method.procedure_description: Potential regulated by potentiostat and successively increased from corrosion potential in 25 mV steps; current recorded after holding each setting for 1 min, under stationary-state conditions. Measured with saturated calomel reference but paper reports potentials versus NHE. No potential-reference conversion is performed. ESCA specimen passivation at +0.946 V for 60 min is a separate treatment.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Authors’ pitting-initiation potential from anodic polarization; no fixed numerical current criterion is specified. Distinct from transpassive dissolution/oxygen evolution at approximately +1.15 V when pitting is inhibited.

experiments.result_note: Approximate manual reading of the discrete marker; connecting line is not an additional observation. Molybdate amount is the reported ion concentration; no salt/ion conversion or pH interpolation is performed. The pH 6.68 example applies to 0.1 M NaCl + 0.1 M Na2MoO4; other exact mixture pH values are not supplied.
